To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
some dairy cows are able to conceive at the first AI during summer heat stress (HS), and that this phenomenon may be related to their thermotolerance.

(1) some cows are able to conceive at the 1 st AI during summer heat stress, (2) these cows are characterized by lower cortisol and HSP 70 concentrations compared to those cows that fail to conceive, (3) the preovulatory surge of LH is of higher magnitude in cows that conceive at the 2 nd AI compared to cows that fail to ovulate at the 2nd AI, (4) the preovulation surge of LH is lower in cows that

(i) some dairy cows are genetically thermotolerant (ii) these cows are able to conceive at the first AI during summer heat stress (iii) the preovulatory luteinizing hormone (LH) surge is higher in these cows than in thermosensitive cows.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the physiological and reproductive features of dairy cows that conceive under high THI during summer.
the identification of the distinctive features of cows that are capable to maintain fertility under severe heat stress conditions.
the identification of dairy cows with conserved reproductive efficiency during HS and the characterization of their physiological and endocrine response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
some dairy cows, despite being subjected to severe heat stress, are able to conceive at the 1 st AI.
the thermotolerance of dairy cows, although a complex trait, may be associated with a lower stress response and conserved reproductive performance under HS conditions.
the cows that conceive under severe summer heat stress have a more effective hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
some cows are more thermotolerant, while others are more thermosensitive and this characteristic is not related to fertility.
, during summer heat stress, some cows with inherent thermotolerance conceive at the first AI, while the majority of the cows with lower thermotolerance do not conceive at all.
, during severe heat stress, some cows are able to conceive at the first AI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, under severe HS, some cows maintain fertility.
, under severe heat stress, some dairy cows have a better stress response and a higher fertility than other cows.
the fertility of some Holstein cows can be preserved under severe HS conditions.
